files.title: File:Sorg Opera House, Main Street, Middletown, OH - 53647121977.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1890, this Richardsonian Romanesque Revival-style building was designed by Samuel Hannaford for Paul J. Sorg to serve as an opera house.  The building features a brick exterior with a rough-hewn stone front facade, arched window bays on the fourth floor of the front facade, a cornice with modillions and dentils, two-over-two and one-over-one double-hung windows, stone pilasters, a modified first floor facade, stone balconies, a rear auditorium wing housing a large theater, and a marquee
